title: Heirs of the Promise
story:
A father once prepared a special inheritance for his children.

The children did not receive it because they had earned it through great achievements.

They received it because they belonged to the family.

Their identity as children gave them a place in the inheritance.

In the same way, when we belong to Christ, we become part of God's family.

Our worth does not come from our background, achievements, wealth, or status.

Through faith in Christ, we become Abraham's descendants and heirs according to God's promise.

This means that God's promises are not distant from us.

We can live with confidence, knowing that we belong to Him and have a secure hope in what He has promised.
life_lesson: When you belong to Christ, you are part of God's family and an heir of His promises. Your identity in Him is greater than your earthly background or achievements.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for making me part of Your family through Jesus Christ.

Thank You that I am an heir according to Your promise.

Help me not to measure my worth by my achievements or circumstances.

Teach me to live confidently as Your child and to trust every promise You have given me.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you sometimes measure your worth by your achievements or circumstances?

How does knowing that you belong to Christ change the way you see yourself?

Which promise of God do you need to trust today?
verse: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
